accumulated_profits_share.zh: 应享有的累计未分配利润和盈余公积份额
accumulated_profits_share.en: Share of accumulated undistributed profits and reserves
accumulated_profits_share.source_zh: 被投资企业资产负债表

acquirer_chargeable_in_hk.zh: 受让方是否在香港就该所得纳税
acquirer_chargeable_in_hk.en: Is the acquirer taxable in Hong Kong on this income?

adequate_substance.zh: 在当地是否有足够的经济实质（人员、场所、开支）
adequate_substance.en: Does the entity have adequate local staff, premises and expenditure?

after_tax_profit.zh: 该公司本年度税后利润
after_tax_profit.en: The company's after-tax profit for this year
after_tax_profit.source_zh: 经审计财务报表（利润表）

amount_unknown.zh: 该步骤的金额是否尚未提供（未提供则须问，不补值）
amount_unknown.en: Is the amount for this step still missing?

arms_length_interest.zh: 关联利息是否符合独立交易原则
arms_length_interest.en: Does the related-party interest comply with the arm's length principle?

arms_length_max.zh: 独立交易区间上限（可扣除金额上限）
arms_length_max.en: Upper deductible amount under the arm's length range
arms_length_max.source_zh: 转让定价同期资料或基准分析报告
arms_length_max.source_en: Contemporaneous transfer-pricing documentation or benchmarking report

as_at.zh: 判断时点（审视本案例的日期）
as_at.en: Date on which the case is assessed

assessment_notice_on.zh: 评税或核定通知书送达日
assessment_notice_on.en: Date the assessment notice was served

asset_disposed_within_2y.zh: 受让方是否在转让后 2 年内处置该资产（新加坡 2014 年规则第 7(1)(b) 条：处置则印花税减免撤回）
asset_disposed_within_2y.en: Will the acquirer dispose of the asset within two years? This may withdraw Singapore stamp duty relief under rule 7(1)(b) of the 2014 rules.

asset_transfer_reasonable_purpose.zh: 按账面净值划转 IP 是否具有合理商业目的、不以减少、免除或推迟缴税为主要目的（109号第三条）
asset_transfer_reasonable_purpose.en: Does the IP transfer at net book value have a reasonable commercial purpose, rather than primarily reducing, avoiding or deferring tax (Notice 109, article 3)?
asset_transfer_reasonable_purpose.source_zh: 划转方案与商业目的说明
asset_transfer_reasonable_purpose.source_en: Transfer plan and commercial purpose statement

associated_ratio.zh: 转让方与受让方之间的共同持股比例（一方持有另一方，或第三方同时持有双方，按链上最低一环）
associated_ratio.en: Common ownership percentage between transferor and transferee, using the lowest link in the ownership chain

authority_action.zh: 税务机关已采取的行动（无 / 评税 / 调整 / 稽查）
authority_action.en: Tax authority action taken: none, assessment, adjustment or audit

benchmark_rate.zh: 金融企业同期同类贷款利率
benchmark_rate.en: Interest rate for comparable financial-institution loans
benchmark_rate.source_zh: 银行报价或贷款合同对照
benchmark_rate.source_en: Bank quotations or comparable loan agreements

beneficial_owner.zh: 收款方是否为受益所有人
beneficial_owner.en: Is the recipient the beneficial owner?

bo_safe_harbour.zh: 是否符合受益所有人安全港（上市公司或其全资子公司等）
bo_safe_harbour.en: Does the recipient qualify for the beneficial-owner safe harbour?

bo_via_100pct_owner.zh: 是否经同一法域的100%持股方认定受益所有人
bo_via_100pct_owner.en: Is beneficial-owner status established through a 100% owner in the same jurisdiction?

capital_asset.zh: 该资产是否为资本性资产（非经营性）
capital_asset.en: Is the asset a capital asset rather than a trading asset?

cfc_profit_total.zh: 受控外国企业利润总额
cfc_profit_total.en: Total profit of the controlled foreign company

cfc_share_control.zh: 是否按持股比例构成控制
cfc_share_control.en: Is control established by share ownership?

cfc_tax_burden_ratio.zh: 受控外国企业实际税负占法定税率的比例
cfc_tax_burden_ratio.en: Effective tax burden as a percentage of the statutory rate
cfc_tax_burden_ratio.source_zh: 该外国企业纳税申报表与财务报表
cfc_tax_burden_ratio.source_en: Foreign company's tax return and financial statements

cfc_whitelisted.zh: 所在法域是否在白名单
cfc_whitelisted.en: Is the jurisdiction on the whitelist?

cit_rate.zh: 该公司实际适用的企业所得税税率（含优惠）
cit_rate.en: Applicable corporate income tax rate, including concessions
cit_rate.source_zh: 企业所得税年度申报表或优惠资格文件
cit_rate.source_en: Annual corporate income tax return or concession eligibility documents

claim_is_for_prior_year.zh: 主张是否针对以前年度
claim_is_for_prior_year.en: Does the claim relate to an earlier year?

clawback_event_within_2y.zh: 两年内是否发生需追回的情形
clawback_event_within_2y.en: Does a clawback event occur within two years?

cn_asset_ratio.zh: 境外企业资产中内地应税财产的比例
cn_asset_ratio.en: Percentage of the foreign company's assets consisting of taxable property in mainland China

cn_income_ratio.zh: 境外企业收入中来自内地的比例
cn_income_ratio.en: Percentage of the foreign company's income arising from mainland China

cn_main_controlling_investor.zh: 是否为该境外企业的主要控股投资者（国税发〔2009〕82号）
cn_main_controlling_investor.en: Is this the main controlling investor of the foreign company (Notice 82 of 2009)?

cn_value_ratio.zh: 股权价值中来自内地应税财产的比例
cn_value_ratio.en: Percentage of share value attributable to taxable property in mainland China

cny_rate.zh: 每单位案例币种折合人民币
cny_rate.en: CNY equivalent of one unit of the case currency
cny_rate.source_zh: 中国人民银行人民币汇率中间价
cny_rate.source_en: People's Bank of China central parity exchange rate

cost_basis.zh: 所转让资产（股权或 IP）的计税成本；IP 为尚未扣除的开支（内地为计税基础减已摊销后的净值）
cost_basis.en: Tax cost of the transferred shares or IP; for IP, the undeducted expenditure or mainland China tax basis net of amortisation
cost_basis.source_zh: 投资或购买凭证、无形资产摊销台账
cost_basis.source_en: Investment or purchase evidence and intangible asset amortisation ledger

covered_taxes_other.zh: 支柱二意义下本法域其他涵盖税额（未在本模型各笔流中体现的部分）
covered_taxes_other.en: Other covered taxes in this jurisdiction for Pillar Two, excluding amounts already in modelled flows

deductible_at_payer.zh: 该笔支付在付款方是否可扣除
deductible_at_payer.en: Is the payment deductible for the payer?

direct_payment.zh: 是否由被投资企业直接支付
direct_payment.en: Is payment made directly by the investee?

distributed_profit_year.zh: 利润分配决议写明本次股息所分配的利润年度（方案新设公司：写明其实际缴税最多的可分配年度）
distributed_profit_year.en: Profit year specified in the dividend resolution; for a newly established company, the actual distributable year with the highest tax paid

dividend_from_pre_reorg_profits.zh: 股息是否分配被转让企业在重组股权转让前形成的未分配利润（公告2013年第72号第八条）
dividend_from_pre_reorg_profits.en: Does the dividend come from profits accumulated before the restructuring share transfer (Announcement 72 of 2013, article 8)?

effective_management_in_cn.zh: 实际管理机构是否在内地（国税发〔2009〕82号四项标准）
effective_management_in_cn.en: Is effective management in mainland China under the four criteria in Notice 82 of 2009?
effective_management_in_cn.source_zh: 董事会纪要与高管工作地
effective_management_in_cn.source_en: Board minutes and senior management work locations

exemption_beneficial.zh: 适用境外所得豁免是否对纳税人有利
exemption_beneficial.en: Is the foreign-income exemption beneficial to the taxpayer?

first_notification_on.en: Date first notified or first becoming aware

fixed_place_in_cn.zh: 在内地是否有固定营业场所
fixed_place_in_cn.en: Is there a fixed place of business in mainland China?

fixed_place_in_hk.zh: 在香港是否有固定营业场所
fixed_place_in_hk.en: Is there a fixed place of business in Hong Kong?

fixed_place_in_sg.zh: 在新加坡是否有固定营业场所
fixed_place_in_sg.en: Is there a fixed place of business in Singapore?

foreign_headline_rate.en: Statutory tax rate in the source jurisdiction

foreign_tax_lower_than_cn.zh: 境外税负是否低于内地
foreign_tax_lower_than_cn.en: Is the foreign tax burden lower than that in mainland China?

foreign_tax_rate.zh: 该笔所得在境外实际缴纳的税额占所得的比例
foreign_tax_rate.en: Foreign tax actually paid as a percentage of the income

foreign_taxed.zh: 该所得在境外是否已纳税
foreign_taxed.en: Has this income been taxed abroad?

ftc_pooling_election.zh: 是否选择新加坡境外税收抵免汇总法
ftc_pooling_election.en: Has Singapore foreign tax credit pooling been elected?

gain_is_capital_in_nature.zh: 处置收益是否属资本性质
gain_is_capital_in_nature.en: Is the disposal gain capital in nature?

globe_income.zh: 支柱二意义下该成员实体的GloBE所得（股息和持股10%以上股权处置利得一般不计入）
globe_income.en: The entity's GloBE income for Pillar Two; dividends and gains on disposals of holdings of at least 10% are generally excluded

government_exempt_condition_met.zh: 政府或协定指定机构的免税条件是否满足
government_exempt_condition_met.en: Are the exemption conditions for a government or treaty-designated institution met?

group_revenue_eur.zh: 集团合并营业收入（欧元，用于支柱二门槛）
group_revenue_eur.en: Consolidated group revenue in EUR for the Pillar Two threshold

gst_input_fully_recoverable.zh: 付款方的进项消费税能否全额抵扣（只作应税或零税率供应）
gst_input_fully_recoverable.en: Can the payer fully recover input GST, making only taxable or zero-rated supplies?

gst_recovery_ratio.zh: 新加坡消费税进项可抵扣比例
gst_recovery_ratio.en: Recoverable percentage of Singapore input GST

held_as_trading_stock.zh: 该股权是否作为交易存货持有
held_as_trading_stock.en: Are the shares held as trading stock?

hk_resident_or_pe.zh: 是否为香港居民或在港常设机构
hk_resident_or_pe.en: Is the entity a Hong Kong resident or a Hong Kong permanent establishment?

hk_tp_small_entity.zh: 是否属香港转让定价小型企业豁免
hk_tp_small_entity.en: Does the Hong Kong transfer-pricing small-entity exemption apply?

holding_months.zh: 支付或处置时的连续持股月数
holding_months.en: Continuous holding period in months at payment or disposal
holding_months.source_zh: 股东名册与股权变动记录
holding_months.source_en: Share register and ownership change records

immovable_ratio.zh: 股权价值中不动产的比例
immovable_ratio.en: Percentage of share value attributable to immovable property

income_sourced_in_hk.en: Is the income sourced in Hong Kong?

income_sourced_in_sg.zh: 该所得是否源自新加坡（在新加坡经营的许可、融资业务所得）
income_sourced_in_sg.en: Is the income sourced in Singapore, including licensing or financing business carried on there?

income_tax_other.zh: 该公司本年度在本案各笔流之外缴纳的所得税（其自身经营利润的所得税，未扣除本案所列付款；本案各笔流上的税由引擎自己计入，勿重复）
income_tax_other.en: Income tax on the company's own operating profits outside the modelled flows, before deducting these payments; do not duplicate taxes calculated on these flows
income_tax_other.source_zh: 纳税申报表与完税凭证

incurred_in_production_of_income.zh: 该支出是否为产生应税收入而发生
incurred_in_production_of_income.en: Was the expenditure incurred to produce taxable income?

incurred_in_production_of_profits.zh: 该支出是否为产生应评税利润而发生
incurred_in_production_of_profits.en: Was the expenditure incurred to produce assessable profits?

indirect_cn_target.zh: 被转让境外企业是否间接持有内地应税财产
indirect_cn_target.en: Does the foreign company indirectly hold taxable property in mainland China?

input_vat_documents_kept.zh: 买方备有书面合同、付款证明和境外单位对账单或发票（凭完税凭证抵扣进项）
input_vat_documents_kept.en: Does the buyer retain the written contract, payment evidence and foreign supplier statement or invoice for input VAT recovery?
input_vat_documents_kept.source_zh: 合同、付款凭证、对账单或发票
input_vat_documents_kept.source_en: Contract, payment evidence, statement or invoice

instrument_used_in_cn.zh: IP 转让书据是否在内地使用（如办理内地专利、商标转让登记）
instrument_used_in_cn.en: Is the IP transfer instrument used in mainland China, such as for patent or trademark registration?
instrument_used_in_cn.source_zh: 国家知识产权局登记材料
instrument_used_in_cn.source_en: China National Intellectual Property Administration registration documents

intragroup_reorg_ratio.zh: 集团内重组的持股比例
intragroup_reorg_ratio.en: Ownership percentage for the intragroup restructuring

investee_encouraged_industry.zh: 被投资企业是否属鼓励类产业
investee_encouraged_industry.en: Is the investee in an encouraged industry?

ip_allowances_claimed.zh: 卖方已就该 IP 获得的扣除或减值津贴合计（香港第 16E/16EA 条、新加坡第 19B 条）
ip_allowances_claimed.en: Total IP deductions or allowances already claimed by the seller under Hong Kong sections 16E/16EA or Singapore section 19B

ip_book_amortization.zh: 买方账上该 IP 每年的摊销额（按其会计政策；算 GloBE 所得与受控外国企业利润）
ip_book_amortization.en: Annual accounting amortisation of the buyer's IP for GloBE income and controlled foreign company profit
ip_book_amortization.source_zh: 买方会计政策与无形资产摊销计划
ip_book_amortization.source_en: Buyer's accounting policies and intangible asset amortisation schedule

ip_book_value.zh: 卖方账上该 IP 的账面价值（计算转让年度的会计利润与 GloBE 所得）
ip_book_value.en: Seller's carrying value of the IP for transfer-year accounting profit and GloBE income
ip_book_value.source_zh: 卖方财务报表、无形资产明细账
ip_book_value.source_en: Seller's financial statements and intangible asset ledger

ip_gain_sourced_in_hk.zh: 出售 IP 的收益是否源自香港
ip_gain_sourced_in_hk.en: Is the IP disposal gain sourced in Hong Kong?
ip_gain_sourced_in_hk.source_zh: 合同谈判、签订与履行地分析
ip_gain_sourced_in_hk.source_en: Analysis of contract negotiation, signing and performance locations

ip_held_as_capital_asset.zh: 所出售的 IP 是否为资本性资产（长期持有用于许可，非买卖存货）
ip_held_as_capital_asset.en: Is the IP held long-term for licensing rather than as trading stock?

ip_kind.zh: 所转让 IP 的种类：PATENT 专利 / SOFTWARE_COPYRIGHT 软件著作权 / IC_LAYOUT 集成电路布图设计 / PLANT_VARIETY 植物新品种 / BIOMEDICINE_VARIETY 生物医药新品种 / KNOW_HOW 专有技术 / TRADEMARK 商标 / COPYRIGHT 其他著作权 / OTHER
ip_kind.en: IP category: patent, software copyright, integrated circuit layout, plant variety, biomedical variety, know-how, trademark, other copyright or other
ip_kind.source_zh: 权属证书、IP 转让协议
ip_kind.source_en: Title certificate and IP transfer agreement

ip_never_owned_by_hk_business.zh: 该知识产权是否从未由香港业务拥有
ip_never_owned_by_hk_business.en: Has the IP never been owned by a Hong Kong business?

ip_transfer_gain_sourced_in_cn.zh: 非居民转让 IP 所有权的所得是否来源于内地（实施条例第七条未列，主管部门未确定）
ip_transfer_gain_sourced_in_cn.en: Is the non-resident's IP ownership transfer income sourced in mainland China? Article 7 does not specify this and the authority has not determined it.
ip_transfer_gain_sourced_in_cn.source_zh: IP 使用地、合同签订与履行地
ip_transfer_gain_sourced_in_cn.source_en: IP use location and contract signing and performance locations

ip_used_in_hk.zh: 知识产权是否在香港使用
ip_used_in_hk.en: Is the IP used in Hong Kong?

ip_useful_life_years.zh: 法律规定或合同约定的 IP 使用年限（如专利剩余保护期）
ip_useful_life_years.en: IP useful life in years under law or contract, such as remaining patent protection
ip_useful_life_years.source_zh: 专利证书、IP 转让协议
ip_useful_life_years.source_en: Patent certificate and IP transfer agreement

is_aircraft_or_ship_lease.zh: 是否为飞机或船舶租赁
is_aircraft_or_ship_lease.en: Is this an aircraft or ship lease?

is_excluded_entity.zh: 是否为新加坡支柱二除外实体
is_excluded_entity.en: Is this an excluded entity for Singapore Pillar Two?

is_mne_member.zh: 是否为跨国企业集团成员
is_mne_member.en: Is the entity a member of a multinational enterprise group?

is_relevant_group_entity.zh: 是否为新加坡意义下的相关集团实体
is_relevant_group_entity.en: Is this a relevant group entity under Singapore rules?

later_cn_tax_not_reduced.zh: 重组后内地税负是否不减少
later_cn_tax_not_reduced.en: Will the mainland China tax burden remain unreduced after restructuring?

lender_interest_taxable_in_hk.zh: 贷款方的利息是否在香港纳税
lender_interest_taxable_in_hk.en: Is the lender's interest taxable in Hong Kong?

limited_functions_and_risks.zh: 境外企业是否仅承担有限功能和风险
limited_functions_and_risks.en: Does the foreign company perform only limited functions and bear limited risks?

listed_market_trade.zh: 是否在公开市场交易上市股份
listed_market_trade.en: Are listed shares traded on a public market?

loan_purpose_income_producing.zh: 借款是否用于产生应税收入
loan_purpose_income_producing.en: Is the loan used to produce taxable income?

managed_from.zh: 实际管理机构所在法域（董事会、高管日常经营决策地）
managed_from.en: Jurisdiction of effective management: board and senior management's daily business decisions
managed_from.source_zh: 董事会纪要与高管工作地
managed_from.source_en: Board minutes and senior management work locations

max_ratio_12m.zh: 前12个月内任一时点的最高持股比例
max_ratio_12m.en: Highest ownership percentage at any time in the preceding 12 months

no_adverse_bo_factors.zh: 受益所有人的不利因素是否均不存在（公告2018年第9号）
no_adverse_bo_factors.en: Are all adverse beneficial-owner factors absent (Announcement 9 of 2018)?

no_main_purpose_of_tax_benefit.zh: 取得该所得是否不以获取税收利益为主要目的
no_main_purpose_of_tax_benefit.en: Is obtaining a tax benefit NOT a main purpose of receiving the income?

no_reasonable_commercial_purpose.zh: 间接转让是否缺乏合理商业目的
no_reasonable_commercial_purpose.en: Does the indirect transfer lack reasonable commercial purpose?

onpay_ratio_12m.zh: 收到后12个月内转付给第三方的比例
onpay_ratio_12m.en: Percentage passed to a third party within 12 months of receipt

p2_additional_allocation.zh: 法域的追加当期补足额没有可分配的成员（新加坡第 16(3)(a) 条 E 为零或香港第 5.4.3 条分配键为零）时税务机关是否仍要求缴纳
p2_additional_allocation.en: Does the authority still require payment when additional current top-up tax has no allocable member under Singapore section 16(3)(a) or Hong Kong article 5.4.3?
p2_additional_allocation.source_zh: 与税务机关的沟通记录

p2_carry_back_topup.zh: 新加坡追加当期补足额中归属于亏损追溯的部分（MMT 法第 21(2) 条选择后仍留在当年）
p2_carry_back_topup.en: Singapore additional current top-up tax attributable to loss carryback remaining in the current year after the section 21(2) election

p2_cbcr_pbt.zh: 国别报告中该法域的税前利润或亏损（与本案例金额同一币种）
p2_cbcr_pbt.en: Jurisdictional profit or loss before tax in the country-by-country report, in the case currency

p2_cbcr_revenue.zh: 国别报告中该法域的总收入（与本案例金额同一币种）
p2_cbcr_revenue.en: Jurisdictional revenue in the country-by-country report, in the case currency

p2_cbcr_simplified_taxes.zh: 该法域的简化涵盖税额：合格财务报表中的所得税费用，剔除非涵盖税、不确定税务处理与被排除的递延税（与本案例金额同一币种）
p2_cbcr_simplified_taxes.en: Simplified covered taxes from qualified financial statements, excluding non-covered taxes, uncertain tax treatments and excluded deferred taxes, in the case currency

p2_dm_avg_income_eur.zh: 该法域当年与前两年 GloBE 所得或亏损的平均数（欧元；新加坡 MMT 法第 19 条、香港 GloBE 第 5.5.2–5.5.3 条）
p2_dm_avg_income_eur.en: Average jurisdictional GloBE income or loss for this and the prior two years in EUR, under Singapore section 19 or Hong Kong articles 5.5.2–5.5.3

p2_dm_avg_revenue_eur.zh: 该法域当年与前两年 GloBE 收入的平均数（欧元；新加坡 MMT 法第 19 条、香港 GloBE 第 5.5.2–5.5.3 条）
p2_dm_avg_revenue_eur.en: Average jurisdictional GloBE revenue for this and the prior two years in EUR, under Singapore section 19 or Hong Kong articles 5.5.2–5.5.3

p2_dm_elected.zh: 申报实体是否为该法域该财年选择适用微利豁免
p2_dm_elected.en: Has the filing entity elected the de minimis exclusion for this jurisdiction and fiscal year?

p2_eur_rate.zh: 每 1 单位本案例币种折合的欧元：财年开始前一个日历年 12 月欧洲央行参考汇率的月平均（新加坡 MMT 条例第 9 条；OECD 2026 年释义第 1 章第 20.1 段）；只用于第一个建模财年，以后各年另给 p2_eur_rate_<年>
p2_eur_rate.en: EUR equivalent of one unit of case currency, using the ECB December monthly average before the fiscal year; applies only to the first modelled year, with separate rates needed for later years

p2_iir.zh: 该补足税伪流是否为母公司按收入纳入规则（IIR）缴纳的份额（口径 D20）
p2_iir.en: Is this top-up tax flow the parent's share under the income inclusion rule?

p2_negative_tax_election.zh: 申报实体是否按新加坡 MMT 法第 21(2) 条选择把追加当期补足额中未归属于亏损追溯的部分转为结转负税额
p2_negative_tax_election.en: Has the filing entity elected under Singapore section 21(2) to carry forward additional current top-up tax not attributable to loss carryback as negative tax?

p2_qualified_cbcr.zh: 该法域该财年有合格国别报告（以合格财务报表编制）
p2_qualified_cbcr.en: Is there a qualified country-by-country report based on qualified financial statements for this jurisdiction and year?

p2_tcsh_elected.zh: 申报实体是否为该法域该财年选择适用过渡期国别报告安全港
p2_tcsh_elected.en: Has the transitional country-by-country reporting safe harbour been elected for this jurisdiction and year?

p2_tcsh_history.zh: 此前每个适用支柱二规则且在该法域有成员的财年都适用了过渡期国别报告安全港（或此前没有这样的年度）
p2_tcsh_history.en: Was the transitional safe harbour used in every earlier applicable Pillar Two year with members in this jurisdiction, or were there no such years?
p2_tcsh_history.source_zh: 以前年度 GloBE 信息申报表

payee_in_source_jur.zh: 收款方是否位于来源地
payee_in_source_jur.en: Is the recipient located in the source jurisdiction?

payee_is_financial_institution.zh: 收款方是否为金融机构
payee_is_financial_institution.en: Is the recipient a financial institution?

payee_is_government.zh: 收款方是否为政府或其全资机构
payee_is_government.en: Is the recipient a government or wholly government-owned institution?

payee_is_related.en: Is the recipient a related party?

payee_resident_in_cn.zh: 收款方是否为内地居民企业
payee_resident_in_cn.en: Is the recipient a mainland China resident enterprise?

payroll.zh: 支柱二实质性所得排除计算用的合资格员工薪酬
payroll.en: Eligible employee payroll for the Pillar Two substance-based income exclusion

pboc_benchmark_rate.zh: 人民银行公布的贷款基准利率
pboc_benchmark_rate.en: Loan benchmark rate published by the People's Bank of China

planned_holding_months.en: Planned remaining holding period in months

ppt.zh: 主要目的测试：是否以获取协定优惠为主要目的之一（是则不给协定待遇）
ppt.en: Is obtaining treaty benefits one of the arrangement's principal purposes? A yes answer fails the principal purpose test.

price_includes_vat.zh: 合同价款是否含增值税
price_includes_vat.en: Does the contract price include VAT?

prior_map_outcome.zh: 以前相互协商程序的结果
prior_map_outcome.en: Outcome of the earlier mutual agreement procedure

profit_margin.zh: 收款方就该笔服务费的利润率
profit_margin.en: Recipient's profit margin on this service fee

profits_arise_in_hk.zh: 该利润是否产生于香港
profits_arise_in_hk.en: Do these profits arise in Hong Kong?

profits_not_mainly_active.zh: 受控外国企业利润是否主要不是积极经营所得
profits_not_mainly_active.en: Are the controlled foreign company's profits mainly NOT active business income?

pure_equity_holding.zh: 是否为纯股权持有实体
pure_equity_holding.en: Is this a pure equity-holding entity?

reasonable_commercial_purpose_absent.zh: 安排是否缺乏合理商业目的（一般反避税）
reasonable_commercial_purpose_absent.en: Does the arrangement lack reasonable commercial purpose for general anti-avoidance purposes?

reasonable_royalty.zh: 特许权使用费是否合理

reasonable_service_fee.zh: 服务费是否合理且与取得收入有关
reasonable_service_fee.en: Is the service fee reasonable and related to earning income?
reasonable_service_fee.source_zh: 服务记录与转让定价资料

receipt_kind.zh: 境外所得的收取方式（汇入 / 视同汇入 / 未汇入）
receipt_kind.en: How was the foreign income received: remitted, deemed remitted or not remitted?

registration_filing_compliant.en: Are registration and filing requirements met?

reinvested_in_cn.zh: 分得利润是否在内地再投资
reinvested_in_cn.en: Are the distributed profits reinvested in mainland China?

reinvestment_from_distributed_profit.zh: 再投资资金是否来自分得利润
reinvestment_from_distributed_profit.en: Does the reinvestment funding come from distributed profits?

remitted_on.en: Date the withheld tax was remitted

reorg_commitment_3y.zh: 转让方是否书面承诺 3 年内不转让其持有的受让方股权（财税〔2009〕59号第七条第（一）项）
reorg_commitment_3y.en: Has the transferor committed in writing not to transfer its shares in the transferee for three years (Notice 59 of 2009, article 7(1))?

reorg_consideration_in_equity.zh: 重组对价是否以股权支付
reorg_consideration_in_equity.en: Is the restructuring consideration paid in equity?

reorg_equity_payment_share.zh: 重组对价中以股权支付的比例
reorg_equity_payment_share.en: Percentage of restructuring consideration paid in equity

reorg_filed.zh: 是否在股权转让合同生效且完成工商变更登记后 30 日内办理特殊性税务处理备案（公告2013年第72号第二条）
reorg_filed.en: Was special tax treatment filed within 30 days after the transfer agreement became effective and business registration changed (Announcement 72 of 2013, article 2)?

reorg_operations_unchanged_12m.zh: 重组后连续 12 个月内是否不改变被转让企业原来的实质性经营活动（59号第五条第（三）项）
reorg_operations_unchanged_12m.en: Will the transferred company's substantive operations remain unchanged for 12 months after restructuring (Notice 59, article 5(3))?

reorg_reasonable_commercial_purpose.zh: 重组是否具有合理商业目的、不以减少免除或推迟缴税为主要目的（59号第五条第（一）项）
reorg_reasonable_commercial_purpose.en: Does restructuring have reasonable commercial purpose rather than primarily reducing, avoiding or deferring tax (Notice 59, article 5(1))?

reorg_shares_kept_12m.zh: 取得股权支付的原主要股东是否在重组后连续 12 个月内不转让所取得的股权（59号第五条第（五）项）
reorg_shares_kept_12m.en: Will the original major shareholders retain equity consideration for 12 months after restructuring (Notice 59, article 5(5))?

reorg_wht_burden_unchanged.zh: 重组后以后该项股权转让所得的预提税负担是否不变（59号第七条第（一）项）
reorg_wht_burden_unchanged.en: Will the withholding tax burden on later transfers of these shares remain unchanged (Notice 59, article 7(1))?

residence_cert.zh: 是否持有收款方居民身份证明（覆盖支付年度）
residence_cert.en: Is a tax residence certificate available for the recipient covering the payment year?

retention_without_reasonable_business_ne.zh: 利润不分配是否缺乏合理经营需要
retention_without_reasonable_business_ne.en: Does the retention of profits lack reasonable business need?
retention_without_reasonable_business_ne.source_en: Explanation of the use of retained profits

royalty_deductible_in_hk.zh: 特许权使用费在香港是否可扣除
royalty_deductible_in_hk.en: Is the royalty deductible in Hong Kong?

sbie.zh: 支柱二实质性所得排除额

sch17k_elected.en: Has Hong Kong Schedule 17K been elected?

service_consumed_on_site_abroad.zh: 服务是否在境外现场消费（如境外会议、住宿、餐饮）
service_consumed_on_site_abroad.en: Is the service consumed on site abroad, such as overseas conferences, accommodation or meals?

service_days_12m.zh: 任意12个月内在来源地提供服务的天数
service_days_12m.en: Days providing services in the source jurisdiction within any 12-month period

service_fee_is_royalty_for_know_how.zh: 服务费是否因使用专有技术而属特许权使用费（国税函〔2009〕507号）
service_fee_is_royalty_for_know_how.en: Is the service fee a royalty for use of know-how (Notice 507 of 2009)?
service_fee_is_royalty_for_know_how.source_zh: 服务合同与技术交付内容

service_kind.zh: 服务类型（管理 / 工程设计咨询 / 其他）
service_kind.en: Service type: management, engineering/design consulting or other

service_onshore_share.zh: 服务在内地履行部分的比例
service_onshore_share.en: Percentage of services performed in mainland China

service_performed_in_residence.zh: 服务是否在居民国履行
service_performed_in_residence.en: Are the services performed in the residence jurisdiction?

service_performed_in_source.zh: 服务是否在来源地履行
service_performed_in_source.en: Are the services performed in the source jurisdiction?

shares_cancelled.zh: 股份是否因清算或减资而注销（无转让书据，不征印花税）
shares_cancelled.en: Are shares cancelled on liquidation or capital reduction without a transfer instrument, so no stamp duty applies?

stamp_relief_claimed.zh: 是否就关联公司之间的转让申请印花税减免（香港印花税条例第 45 条；新加坡印花税法第 15 条）
stamp_relief_claimed.en: Has associated-company transfer stamp duty relief been claimed under Hong Kong section 45 or Singapore section 15?

substance_ruled_adequate.zh: 香港税务局是否已认定经济实质足够
substance_ruled_adequate.en: Has Hong Kong's tax authority ruled that economic substance is adequate?

substantive_control_over_foreign_company.zh: 是否对外国企业构成实质控制
substantive_control_over_foreign_company.en: Is there substantive control over the foreign company?
substantive_control_over_foreign_company.source_zh: 股权、资金、经营与购销关系
substantive_control_over_foreign_company.source_en: Ownership, funding, operating, purchasing and sales relationships

tangible_assets.zh: 支柱二实质性所得排除计算用的有形资产账面价值
tangible_assets.en: Carrying value of tangible assets for the Pillar Two substance-based income exclusion

tax_paid_or_secured.zh: 税款是否已缴纳或提供担保
tax_paid_or_secured.en: Has tax been paid or secured?

tech_recognition_open_to_foreign_seller.zh: 境外卖方的技术转让能否经内地科技、工信部门认定而免征增值税
tech_recognition_open_to_foreign_seller.en: Can the foreign seller's technology transfer be recognised by mainland China technology or industry authorities for VAT exemption?
tech_recognition_open_to_foreign_seller.source_en: Opinion of the competent tax authority

tech_transfer_between_sisters_allowed.zh: 同一股东全资持有的兄弟公司之间的技术转让能否享受减免（111号第四条未写）
tech_transfer_between_sisters_allowed.en: Can a technology transfer between wholly owned sister companies qualify for relief where Notice 111, article 4 is silent?

tech_transfer_registered.zh: 技术转让合同已经省级以上科技部门（跨境：商务部门）认定登记
tech_transfer_registered.en: Has the technology transfer contract been registered with the provincial or higher science authority, or the commerce authority for cross-border transfers?
tech_transfer_registered.source_zh: 技术合同认定登记证明
tech_transfer_registered.source_en: Technology contract recognition and registration certificate

technology_export_restricted.zh: 所转让技术是否属于《中国禁止出口限制出口技术目录》所列
technology_export_restricted.en: Is the technology included in China's prohibited or restricted technology export catalogue?

tp_adjustment_paid_on.zh: 转让定价调整税款缴纳日
tp_adjustment_paid_on.en: Payment date of the transfer-pricing tax adjustment

tp_adjustment_tax.en: Additional tax from the transfer-pricing adjustment

tp_documentation_provided.zh: 是否已准备并提供同期资料
tp_documentation_provided.en: Has contemporaneous transfer-pricing documentation been prepared and provided?

underlying_profits_taxed.zh: 股息所对应利润是否已纳税
underlying_profits_taxed.en: Have the profits underlying the dividend been taxed?

underlying_tax_share.zh: 股息所对应的已纳税额占股息的比例
underlying_tax_share.en: Tax already paid on the underlying profits as a percentage of the dividend
underlying_tax_share.source_zh: 付款方纳税申报与利润分配记录
underlying_tax_share.source_en: Payer's tax return and profit distribution records

unified_borrowing_relending.zh: 这笔利息是否属于统借统还：集团或核心企业向金融机构借款（或发债）后转贷给下属单位，利率不高于其借款利率
unified_borrowing_relending.en: Is this qualifying group borrowing and on-lending, with interest no higher than the group's bank borrowing or bond rate?
unified_borrowing_relending.source_zh: 集团借款合同、转贷合同与利率
unified_borrowing_relending.source_en: Group borrowing and on-lending agreements and interest rates

unwind_step.zh: 该笔转让是否为撤销或迁出现有控股公司的步骤（口径 D19）
unwind_step.en: Is this transfer a step in closing or relocating the existing holding company?

vat_general_taxpayer.zh: 付款方是否为增值税一般纳税人
vat_general_taxpayer.en: Is the payer a general VAT taxpayer?

vat_tech_recognized.zh: 技术转让合同已经省级科技、工信部门认定（免征增值税）
vat_tech_recognized.en: Has the technology transfer contract been recognised by the provincial science or industry authority for VAT exemption?
vat_tech_recognized.source_zh: 科技、工信部门审核意见

wound_up_by_plan.zh: 该公司是否按方案转出所持股权后清算注销（口径 D19）
wound_up_by_plan.en: Will the company be liquidated after transferring its shares under the plan?

reduced_capital_ratio.zh: 减资占实收资本的比例
reduced_capital_ratio.en: Capital reduction as a percentage of paid-in capital
